from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from .models import VaultFolder

class MoveVaultFolderView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request, folder_id):
        folder = get_object_or_404(VaultFolder, id=folder_id, owner=request.user)
        target_parent_id = request.data.get("target_parent_id")
        target_parent = get_object_or_404(VaultFolder, id=target_parent_id)

        folder.move_to(target_parent, position="first-child")
        return Response({"status": "moved", "folder_id": folder.id, "new_parent_id": target_parent.id})
diagnosis: While the view validates that request.user owns the folder being moved (folder_id), it looks up target_parent solely by ID without verifying that request.user owns or has write permissions on target_parent. An attacker can move folders into another user's private vault tree.

from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from .models import VaultFolder

class MoveVaultFolderView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request, folder_id):
        folder = get_object_or_404(VaultFolder, id=folder_id, owner=request.user)
        target_parent_id = request.data.get("target_parent_id")
        target_parent = get_object_or_404(VaultFolder, id=target_parent_id, owner=request.user)

        folder.move_to(target_parent, position="first-child")
        return Response({"status": "moved", "folder_id": folder.id, "new_parent_id": target_parent.id})
